inheritanceRule: Every omitted field inherits the resolved parent class value.

profiles.name: Flying Blade

constraints.summary: Most defining features require daggers or starknives.

evidence.reason: Thrown daggers and starknives gain range, damage, critical and panache support.

profiles.playerSummary: A Swashbuckler specialised in throwing daggers and starknives with panache, precision and unusual reach.
profiles.tradeoff: Its panache engine and scaling benefits are tightly restricted to two weapon families.

profiles.name: Picaroon

constraints.summary: The intended style pairs a one-handed firearm with a light or one-handed piercing weapon.

evidence.reason: Firearm attacks are integrated directly into the Swashbuckler’s two-weapon routine.

profiles.playerSummary: A Swashbuckler who fights with a pistol in one hand and a finesse weapon in the other.
profiles.tradeoff: The hybrid style is equipment intensive and several deeds are replaced by firearm-specific techniques.

profiles.name: Magical Child

evidence.reason: A scaling magical familiar participates in both identities and can deliver vigilante appearance abilities.

profiles.playerSummary: A transforming Vigilante with limited spontaneous arcane magic and a magical familiar that grows into a true combat partner.
profiles.tradeoff: Skills and armour are reduced, and the spell, identity and familiar subsystems create a demanding character.

profiles.name: Gunmaster

evidence.section: Weapon and Armor Proficiencies / Gunmaster Talents
evidence.reason: Gunsmithing and an extensive firearm-talent progression define the vigilante identity.

profiles.playerSummary: A firearm Vigilante with gunsmithing, specialised gun talents and light-armour agility.
profiles.tradeoff: Martial weapons and medium armour are lost, while effectiveness depends heavily on firearms and ammunition.

profiles.name: Sacred Fist

constraints.summary: AC and flurry benefits require remaining unarmoured, unshielded and lightly encumbered.
constraints.evidenceSection: Weapon and Armor Proficiency / AC Bonus

evidence.reason: Unarmed damage and unarmoured Wisdom defence replace sacred-weapon and armour dependence.

profiles.playerSummary: An unarmoured Warpriest combining divine spells and fervour with Monk-style flurry, unarmed damage, ki and saving resilience.
profiles.tradeoff: Armour and shield use disable central benefits, and several bonus feats and sacred-weapon features are replaced.

profiles.name: Shieldbearer

constraints.summary: Sacred weapon, sacred shield and altered channel energy all depend on carrying a shield.

evidence.reason: Scaling divine shield enhancement and defensive properties make shield defence central.

profiles.playerSummary: A Warpriest who makes the shield both sacred weapon and divinely enhanced defence.
profiles.tradeoff: Several class features arrive later or function only while carrying a shield, creating strong equipment dependence.

profiles.name: White-Haired Witch

evidence.reason: A reach natural attack automatically attempts grapple and later gains constrict and manipulation abilities.

profiles.playerSummary: A Witch whose supernatural hair becomes a reach weapon that grapples, constricts and manipulates enemies.
profiles.tradeoff: The entire hex progression is replaced by close-combat hair and a narrow selection of Rogue talents.

profiles.name: Havocker

constraints.summary: One kineticist element replaces the normal patron and determines blast and infusion access.

evidence.reason: A scaling kinetic blast becomes the reliable offensive centre of the Witch.

profiles.playerSummary: A Witch who trades patron spells and hexes for an elemental kinetic blast powered and modified through sacrificed spells.
profiles.tradeoff: Most hex-based debuffing and utility disappear, and infusion use consumes prepared spell slots.

profiles.name: Spellslinger

constraints.summary: One or two firearms become arcane guns used to deliver and enhance spells.

evidence.reason: Firearms deliver spells, improve attack DCs and convert spell slots into gun enhancements.

profiles.playerSummary: A Wizard who channels spells through one or two arcane firearms and converts spell energy into magical ammunition.
profiles.tradeoff: Four opposition schools and intense firearm dependence substantially narrow the Wizard’s usual breadth.

profiles.name: Arcane Physician

professionIdentity.evidenceText: The named archetype explicitly practises medicine through alchemical healing items and potion construction.

evidence.reason: Healing-subschool alchemist magic can be activated from items and supplied through crafted potions.

profiles.playerSummary: A Wizard physician who accesses healing through alchemical magic items and can build restorative potions without knowing the spells.
profiles.tradeoff: Healing remains item-mediated rather than ordinary Wizard casting and replaces scroll-focused development.
